arabic_text: إلهِي هَدَيْتَنِي فَلَهَوْتُ، وَوَعَظْتَ فَقَسَوْتُ، وَأَبْلَيْتَ الْجَمِيلَ فَعَصَيْتُ،
transliteration: ilāhī hadaytanī falahawtu wa waʿaẓta faqasawtu wa-ablaytal jamila fa'asaytu
english_text: My God, Thou guided me but I diverted myself, Thou admonished me but my heart became hardened, Thou tried me graciously but I disobeyed.

arabic_text: ثُمَّ عَرَفْتُ مَا أَصْدَرْتَ؟
transliteration: thumma ʿarraftu mā ʾaṣdarta?
english_text: Then, when Thou caused me to know it, I came to know that from

arabic_text: إذْ عَرَّفْتَنِيهِ فَاسْتَغْفَرْتُ، فَأَقَلْتَ فَعُدتُ، فَسَتَرْتَ فَلَكَ إلهِي الْحَمْدُ.
transliteration: 'idh 'arraftaniihi fastaghfartu, fa'aqalt fa'udtu fasatar-ta falaka ilahi alhamd
english_text: which Thou hadst turned [me] away, so I prayed forgiveness and Thou released, and I returned and Thou covered over. So Thine, my God, is the praise!

arabic_text: تَقَحَّمْتُ أَوْدِيَةَ الْهَلاَكِ، وَحَلَلْتُ شِعَابَ تَلَف تَعَرَّضْتُ فِيهَا لِسَطَوَاتِكَ، وَبِحُلُولِهَا عُقُوبَاتِكَ،
transliteration: taqaḥḥamtu ʾawdiyat al-halāk wa ḥalaltu shiʿāba talafta ʿarraḍtu fīhā lisṭawātika wa bihuloolihaa 'uqubatika
english_text: I plunged into the valleys of destruction and settled in the ravines of ruin, exposing myself to Thy chastisements and the descent of Thy punishments!

arabic_text: وَوَسِيلَتِي إلَيْكَ التَّوْحِيدُ، وَذَرِيْعَتِي أَنِّي لَمْ أُشْرِكْ بِكَ شَيْئاً، وَلَمْ أَتَّخِذْ مَعَكَ إلهاً،
transliteration: wa wasīlatī ilayka attawḥīdu wa-dharīʿatī annī lam ushrik bika shay'an wa lam at-takhiḏ maʿaka ilāhan
english_text: My mediation with Thee is the profession of Unity, my way of coming to Thee that I associate nothing with Thee, nor do I take along with Thee a god;

arabic_text: وَقَدْ فَرَرْتُ إلَيْكَ بِنَفْسِي، وَإلَيْكَ مَفَرُّ الْمُسِيءِ، وَمَفْزَعُ الْمُضَيِّعِ لِحَظِّ نَفْسِهِ، الْمُلْتَجِئِ.
transliteration: waqad farartu ilayka bi nafsi wa-ilayka mafarru al-musi'i wa-mafza'u al-mudayyi'i lihazz nafsihi, al-multaji'i
english_text: I have fled to Thee with my soul - in Thee is the place of flight for the evildoer, the place of escape for him who has squandered the share of his soul and seeks asylum.

arabic_text: فَكَمْ مِنْ عَدُوٍّ انْتَضى عَلَيَّ سَيْفَ عَدَاوَتِهِ، وَشَحَذَ لِيْ ظُبَةَ مُدْيَتِهِ، وَأَرْهَفَ لِي شَبَا حَدِّهِ، وَدَافَ لِيْ قَوَاتِلَ سُمُومِهِ،
transliteration: fakam min 'aduwwin intadha 'alayya sayfa 'adaawatihi wa shahadha li dhuba mudiyatihi wa arhafa li shabaha haddihi wa dāfa lī qawātila sumūmihī
english_text: How many an enemy has unsheathed the sword of his enmity toward me, honed the cutting edge of his knife for me, sharpened the tip of his blade for me, mixed his killing potions for me,

arabic_text: وَسَدَّدَ نَحْوِي صَوَائِبَ سِهَامِهِ، وَلَمْ تَنَمْ عَنِّي عَيْنُ حِرَاسَتِهِ، وَأَضْمَرَ أَنْ يَسُومَنِي الْمَكْرُوهَ وَيُجَرِّ عَنِّي زُعَافَ مَرَارَتِهِ ،
transliteration: wasaddada nahwi sawa'iba sihamihi walam tanam ʿanni ʿaynu ḥirāsatihi wa 'admar(a) 'an yasūmanī al-makrūh(a) wa yujarri 'annī zu'āf(a) marāratihi
english_text: pointed toward me his straight-flying arrows, not allowed the eye of his watchfulness to sleep toward me, and secretly thought of visiting me with something hateful and making me gulp down the bitter water of his bile!

arabic_text: فَنَظَرْتَ يا إلهِيْ إلَى ضَعْفِي عَنِ احْتِمَـالِ الْفَـوَادِحِ ، وَعَجْزِي عَنِ الانْتِصَارِ مِمَّنْ قَصَدَنِيْ بِمُحَارَبَتِهِ، وَوَحْدَتِي فِي كَثِيرِ عَدَدِ مَنْ نَاوَانِيْ وَأَرْصَدَ لِيْ بِالْبَلاءِ فِيمَا لَمْ أُعْمِلْ فِيهِ فِكْرِي،
transliteration: fa-naẓart(a) yā ilāhī ilā ḍaʿfī ʿan(i) iḥtimāl(i) al-fawād(i)ḥ waʿajzi ʿani al-intiṣāri mimmān qaṣadani bimuḥārabatih wa waḥdatī fī kathīri ʿadadi man nāwānī wa arṣada lī bil-balāʾ fīmā lam uʿmil fīhi fikrī
english_text: So Thou looked my God, at my weakness in bearing oppressive burdens, my inability to gain victory over him who aims to war against me, and my being alone before the great numbers of him who is hostile toward me and lies in wait for me with an affliction about which I have not thought.

arabic_text: فَابْتَدَأْتَنِي بِنَصْرِكَ، وَشَدَدْتَ أَزْرِي بِقُوَّتِكَ،
transliteration: fa'btada'tanī bi-naṣrika wa shaddaḍta azrī biqūwwatika
english_text: Thou set out at once to help me and Thou braced up my back!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ فَلَلْتَ لِيَ حَدَّهُ، وَصَيَّرْتَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ جَمْع عَدِيْد وَحْدَهُ، وَأَعْلَيْتَ كَعْبِي عَلَيْهِ، وَجَعَلْتَ مَا سَدَّدَهُ مَرْدُوداً عَلَيْهِ،
transliteration: thumma fallaltu liyahaddahu waṣayyartahu min baʿdi jamʿ ʿadīd waḥdahu wa'a'laita kaʿbi ʿalayhi wa jaʿaltama saddadahu mardūdan ʿalayhi
english_text: Thou blunted for me his blade, made him, after a great multitude, solitary, raised up my heel over him, and turned back upon him what he had pointed straight.

arabic_text: فَرَدَدْتَهُ لَمْ يَشْفِ غَيْظَهُ، وَلَمْ يَسْكُنْ غَلِيلُهُ،
transliteration: faradadtahu lam yashfi ghayzahu walam yas-kun ghaleeluhu
english_text: So Thou sent him back, his rage not calmed, his burning thirst not quenched!

arabic_text: قَدْ عَضَّ عَلَى شَوَاهُ، وَأَدْبَرَ مُوَلِّياً قَدْ أَخْلَفَتَ سَرَاياهُ.
transliteration: qad ʿadda ʿalā shawāhu wa adbara muwalliyan qad akhlafat sarayahu
english_text: Biting his fingers, he turned his back in flight, his columns having been of no use.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ باغ بَغانِيْ بِمَكَائِدِهِ، وَنَصَبَ لِيْ شَرَكَ مَصَائِدِهِ، وَوَكَّلَ بِيْ تَفَقُّدَ رِعَايَتِهِ، وَأَظْبَأَ إلَيَّ إظْبَآءَ السَّبُعِ لِطَرِيْدَتِهِ،
transliteration: wa kam min bāgh baghānī bimakāʾidihi wa naṣaba lī sharaka maṣāʾidihi wa wak̲k̲ala bī tafaqquḏa rīʿāyatihi wa ʾaẓbaʾa ʾilayya iẓbāʾa al-sabʿi liṭarīdatihi
english_text: How many an oppressor has oppressed me with his tricks, set up for me the net of his snares, appointed over me the inspection of his regard, and lay in ambush for me, the lying in ambush of a predator for its game,

arabic_text: انْتِظَـاراً لانْتِهَازِ الْفُرْصَةِ لِفَرِيسَتِهِ، وَهُوَ يُظْهِرُ لِيْ بَشَاشَةَ المَلَقِ، وَيَنْظُـرُنِي عَلَى شِدَّةِ الْحَنَقِ،
transliteration: intiẓāran li-intihāzi al-fursati li-farīsatihi wa huwa yuzhiru li bashashata al-malaqi wa yanzuruni ʿala shiddati al-ḥanaq
english_text: waiting to take advantage of its prey, while he showed me the smile of the flatterer and looked at me with the intensity of fury!

arabic_text: فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتَ يَا إلهِي تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ دَغَلْ سَرِيرَتِهِ، وَقُبْحَ مَا انْطَوى عَلَيْهِ، أَرْكَسْتَهُ لاُِمِّ رَأْسِهِ فِي زُبْيَتِهِ، وَرَدَدْتَهُ فِي مَهْوى حُفْرَتِهِ،
transliteration: falammā ra'ayta yā ilāhī tabārakta wa ta'ālayta daġal sarīratihi wa qubḥa mā inṭawá ʿalayhi, arkasta-hu lā ummi raʾsihi fī zubayti-hi waraddatahu fi mahwahi hufra tih
english_text: So when Thou saw, my God, (blessed art Thou and high exalted) the depravity of his secret thoughts and the ugliness of what he harboured, Thou threw him on his head into his own pitfall and dumped him into the hole of his own digging.

arabic_text: فَانْقَمَعَ بَعْدَ اسْتِطَالَتِهِ ذَلِيلاً فِي رِبَقِ حِبالتِهِ الَّتِي كَانَ يُقَدِّرُ أَنْ يَرَانِي فِيهَا،
transliteration: fa-anqama baʿda istiṭālatihi dhaleelan fī ribaqi ḥibāltihi al-latī kāna yuqaddiru an yarānī fīhā
english_text: So he was brought down low, after his overbearing, by the nooses of his own snare, wherein he had thought he would see me;

arabic_text: وَقَدْ كَادَ أَنْ يَحُلَّ بِيْ لَوْلاَ رَحْمَتُكَ مَا حَلَّ بِسَاحَتِهِ.
transliteration: waqad kaada an yahulla biy lawla rahmatuka ma halla bisaahatihi
english_text: and what came down upon his courtyard - had it not been for Thy mercy - was on the point of coming down upon me!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ حَاسِد قَدْ شَرِقَ بِي بِغُصَّتِهِ، وَشَجِيَ مِنِّي بِغَيْظِهِ، وَسَلَقَنِي بِحَدِّ لِسَانِهِ، وَوَحَرَنِي بِقَرْفِ عُيُوبِهِ، وَجَعَلَ عِرْضِيْ غَرَضاً لِمَرَامِيهِ،
transliteration: wa kam min hasid qad shariqua bi bi-ghussatih wa shajiyah minni bi-ghayzihi, wa salaqa-ni bi-haddi lisaanihi wa waharani biqarfi ʿuyubih wa jaaʿala ʿirḍiy gharadan li maraamihi
english_text: How many an evier has choked upon me in his agony, fumed over me in his rage, cut me with the edge of his tongue, showed malice toward me by accusing me of his own faults, made my good repute the target of his shots,

arabic_text: وَقَلَّدَنِي خِلاَلاً لَمْ تَزَلْ فِيهِ، وَوَحَرنِي بِكَيْدِهِ، وَقَصَدَنِي بِمَكِيدَتِهِ،
transliteration: waqalladani khilalan lam tazal feehi wa waharni bikaidehi, wa qasadani bimakeedatahi
english_text: collared me with his own constant defects, showed malice toward me with his trickery, and aimed at me with his tricks!

arabic_text: فَنَادَيْتُكَ يَا إلهِي مُسْتَغِيْثاً بِكَ، وَاثِقاً بِسُرْعَةِ إجَابَتِكَ، عَالِماً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُضْطَهَدُ مَنْ آوى إلَى ظِلِّ كَنَفِكَ، وَلاَ يَفْزَعُ مَنْ لَجَأَ إلَى مَعْقِل انْتِصَارِكَ،
transliteration: fanādaytuka yā ilāhī mustaghīthan bika waathiqan bisur'ati ijābatika 'āliman annahu lā yuḍṭahadu man āwā ilā ẓillik kanafik wala yafzaʿu man laja'a ila maqil intsarik
english_text: So I called upon Thee, my God, seeking aid from Thee, trusting in the speed of Thy response, knowing that he who seeks haven in the shadow of Thy wing will not be mistreated, and he who seeks asylum in the stronghold of Thy victory will not be frightened.

arabic_text: فَحَصَّنْتَنِي مِنْ بَأْسِهِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
transliteration: faḥaṣṣantani min ba'sihi biqudratika
english_text: So Thou fortified me against his severity through Thy power.

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ سَحَائِبِ مَكْرُوه جَلَّيْتَهَا عَنِّي، وَسَحَائِبِ نِعَم أَمْطَرْتَهَا عَلَيَّ، وَجَدَاوِلِ رَحْمَة نَشَرْتَهَا، وَعَافِيَة أَلْبَسْتَهَا، وَأَعْيُنِ أَحدَاث طَمَسْتَهَا،
transliteration: wa kam min saḥā'ibi makruwah jallaytahā 'annī wasahā'ibi niʿma 'amtarthāhā ʿalayya wa jadāwil raḥmah nashartha waʿāfiya ʾalbasṭahā, waʾaʿyuni ʾaḥdāth ṭamastahā
english_text: How many a cloud of detested things Thou hast dispelled from me, a cloud of favour Thou hast made rain down upon me, a stream of mercy Thou hast let flow, a well-being in which Thou hast clothed me, an eye of mishap Thou hast blinded,

arabic_text: وَغَواشي كُرُبَات كَشَفْتَهَا،
transliteration: wa-ghawāshi kurubāt kashafatahā
english_text: and a wrap of distress Thou hast removed!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ ظَنٍّ حَسَن حَقَّقْتَ، وَعَدَم جَبَرْتَ، وَصَرْعَة أَنْعَشْتَ وَمَسْكَنَة، حَوَّلْتَ،
transliteration: wa kam min thanin hasan haqqaqta, wa 'adam jabarta wa ṣarʿah anʿashta wa maskanah, hawwalta
english_text: How many a good opinion Thou hast verified, a destitution Thou hast redressed, an infirmity Thou hast restored to health, and a misery Thou hast transformed!

arabic_text: كُلُّ ذَلِكَ إنْعَامَاً وَتَطَوُّلاً مِنْكَ، وَفِي جَمِيعِهِ انْهِمَاكاً مِنِّي عَلَى مَعَاصِيْكَ،
transliteration: kullu dhālika inʿāmān wa taṭawwulan minka wa fī jamiʿihi inhimākan minnī ʿalā maʿāsīka
english_text: All of that was favour and graciousness from Thee, and in all of it I was occupied with acts of disobeying Thee.

arabic_text: لَمْ تَمْنَعْكَ إساءَتِي عَنْ إتْمَامِ إحْسَانِكَ، وَلاَ حَجَرَنِي ذالِكَ عَنِ ارْتِكَابِ مَسَاخِطِكَ،
transliteration: lam tamnaʿka issaʾati ʿan itmami ihsanika walā ḥajaranī dhālika ʿani irtikābī masākhiti-ka
english_text: My evildoing did not hinder Thee from completing Thy beneficence, nor was I stopped from committing acts displeasing to Thee.

arabic_text: لاَ تُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَفْعَلُ، وَلَقَدْ سُئِلْتَ فَأَعْطَيْتَ،
transliteration: lā tusʾal ʿammā tafʿal, wa laqad suʾilt fa-aʿṭayt
english_text: Thou art not questioned as to what Thou dost! Thou wert asked, and Thou bestowed.

arabic_text: وَلَمْ تُسْأَلْ فابْتَدَأْتَ، وَاسْتُمِيحَ فَضْلُكَ فَمَا أَكْدَيْتَ،
transliteration: walam tus'al fabtada'ta, wa istumih fadluka fa ma akdayta
english_text: Thou wert not asked, and Thou began. Thy bounty was requested, and Thou didst not skimp.

arabic_text: أَبَيْتَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ إلاَّ إحْسَانَـاً وَامْتِنَاناً وَتَطوُّلاً وَإنْعَامـاً ، وَأَبَيْتُ إلاَّ تَقَحُّماً لِحُرُماتِكَ، وَتَعَدِّياً لِحُدُودِكَ، وَغَفْلَةً عَنْ وَعِيدِكَ.
transliteration: abayta ya mawlaya illa ihsanaً waamtinānan wa taṭawwulānan wa inʿāman wa 'abaytu illa taqaḥḥuman li-ḥurumātika wa taʿaddiyan lihududika, wa ghaflatan ʿan waʿidika
english_text: Thou refused, my Master, everything but beneficence, kindness, graciousness, and favour, and I refused everything but plunging into what Thou hast made unlawful, transgressing Thy bounds, and paying no heed to Thy threat!
